intent: Ingests biometrics via HttpClient: loadSnapshot() = GET /api/telemetry/snapshot; startStream() polls GET /api/telemetry/live every 2000 ms (rxjs timer + switchMap, idempotent); stopStream() unsubscribes. Both return BiometricMetric. Sets metric/loading/error signals. Injects ToastStore and calls show(message, 'warning') when heartRate > 180 or respiratoryRate > 40 (once per threshold crossing). ToastStore contract: ToastStore (providedIn root) { readonly toasts: Signal<readonly Notification[]>; show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string; dismiss(id: string): void; clear(): void }. Public API exactly: BiometricTelemetryService (providedIn root) { readonly metric: Signal<BiometricMetric | null>; readonly loading: Signal<boolean>; readonly error: Signal<string | null>; loadSnapshot(): void; startStream(): void; stopStream(): void }. Imports BiometricMetric from core/models/biometric-metric.model.ts.
